jobs.title: Audio Visual Technician – Audio Engineer
jobs.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

**Job Overview**
----------------

LPL Financial is seeking an **Audio Visual Technician – Audio Engineer** with a strong background in audio engineering and live production to support corporate meetings, executive presentations, town halls, livestreams, and special events.

This role will primarily focus on professional audio production, including live sound mixing, microphone systems, audio signal routing, recording, system configuration, and troubleshooting. The position will also provide general AV and event support, including equipment setup and strike.

The ideal candidate is technically skilled, dependable, customer-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced corporate environment supporting high-visibility events.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

Audio Production & Engineering

* Set up, operate, and troubleshoot professional audio systems for corporate meetings, executive events, town halls, livestreams, and live productions.
* Operate digital audio consoles, wireless microphone systems, playback devices, processors, and related professional audio equipment.
* Mix live audio for in-room audiences, broadcasts, livestreams, recordings, and virtual participants.
* Manage audio signal flow, routing, gain structure, EQ, dynamics processing, and overall system levels.
* Set up and manage wireless lavalier, handheld, podium, and other microphone systems.
* Perform sound checks and ensure clear, consistent audio throughout live events.
* Monitor RF and wireless microphone performance and quickly identify and resolve interference or connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot audio issues including feedback, distortion, signal loss, routing problems, and equipment failures.
* Support audio integration with video conferencing, livestreaming, recording, and broadcast systems.
* Record event audio and assist with media management and archiving as needed.

General AV & Event Support

* Set up, operate, and strike AV equipment for meetings, conferences, and corporate events.
* Provide general support for video systems, displays, projectors, lighting, presentation systems, and video conferencing.
* Set up and strike pipe and drape, staging, and other event production equipment as needed.
* Run, secure, and manage AV cabling while maintaining safe, clean, and professional event spaces.
* Assist with equipment testing, maintenance, inventory, and organization.
* Participate in rehearsals, pre-production meetings, event setup, and post-event breakdown.
* Partner with presenters, executives, producers, event teams, and other AV professionals to deliver a high-quality event experience.

Primary Areas of Responsibility

Audio Engineering | Live Sound | Corporate Events | Livestreaming | Broadcast Audio | General AV Support

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* **Live Video Production & Multi-Camera Operation:** minimum of 3 years supporting live corporate events, broadcasts, town halls, or livestreams with hands-on operation of professional cameras, PTZ cameras, and multi-camera production environments.
* **Video Engineering & Signal Flow:** proven experience configuring and troubleshooting video signal routing, switching, distribution, resolutions, and frame rates with strong knowledge of SDI, HDMI, and NDI technologies.
* **Livestreaming & Recording:** experience supporting livestreams, virtual events, encoding, recording, and content distribution and ability to monitor and troubleshoot live productions in real time.
* **Video Switching & Production Equipment:** hands-on experience operating video switchers, routers, recording systems, monitors, and production control equipment.
* **Video Editing & Post-Production:** experience editing recorded content using Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar platforms and ability to create polished internal communications, executive videos, and event recordings.

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Professional video production and video engineering
* Multi-camera production
* Livestreaming and virtual event support
* Video signal routing and troubleshooting
* Camera setup, framing, focus, exposure, and color matching
* Presentation playback and confidence monitors
* Recording and media management
* Video quality control during live events
* Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Webex support
* Audio, display, projector, and lighting support
* General AV event setup and breakdown
* Cable management and event safety
* Equipment testing, maintenance, inventory, and organization
* Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving
* Customer service and executive support
* Ability to perform under pressure during live events
* Team collaboration and event coordination

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Experience supporting executive-level meetings and town halls
* Corporate studio or broadcast production experience
* Advanced livestreaming workflows
* Advanced multi-camera production experience
* Strong post-production and video editing background
* Experience with vMix, OBS, Wirecast, or similar production platforms
* Knowledge of network-based AV/video technology

**Pay Range:**

$34.47-$57.44/hour

jobs.title: SoC Audio Engineer, Platform Architecture
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you love crafting elegant solutions to the hardest problems in audio and acoustics? Are you a big-picture, forward-thinking engineer who understands how audio subsystems integrate into a SoC and a system? At Apple, our Architecture group is responsible for connecting the hardware and software that bring sound to life across our products. Join this team, and you'll collaborate with engineers across Apple to design how our audio technologies work in unison!
  
  
Description
  
  
We are looking for a SoC Audio Architect to join our team defining the audio subsystem architecture for Apple's SoCs — technology that powers experiences across nearly every Apple product, from ultra-low-power keyword detection to high-fidelity spatial audio. This is primarily an audio subsystem architecture role, not an audio IP design role; experience designing audio IP is valued as background but is not the core function of the position. In this highly visible role, you will own the multi-generational subsystem architecture and roadmap for audio subsystems, collaborating closely with Silicon Engineering, Software Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to size subsystems and optimize trade-offs between performance, power, and area. You will have visibility across every product line and be accountable for architectures that scale across the portfolio, from early concept through tape-out and into shipping product.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience with SoC architecture principles
* Experience with SoC audio processing

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Master's degree with 10+ years of relevant industry experience
* Experience defining architecture specifications for audio, DSP, or signal processing subsystems within an SoC
* In-depth understanding of SoC architecture concepts, such as on-chip fabric protocols, memory concepts, and clocking, reset, and power management
* Skilled in digital signal processing algorithms, including audio algorithms
* Understanding of SoC power modeling and Power/Performance/Area (PPA) optimization
* Understanding of SoC audio interfaces (e.g., I2S, PDM, TDM, MIPI SWI3S)
* Proficiency in hardware/software co-design, including familiarity with RTL design concepts (e.g., System Verilog)
* Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across organizations.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $263,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.  
  
  

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace  
  
Learn about reasonable accommodations for job applicants

  
  
  

Apple accepts applications to this posting on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Padres Production - Audio Technician
jobs.description:
**TITLE:** Padres Production -Audio Technician

**DEPARTMENT:** Scoreboard Operations

**REPORTS TO:** Director, Scoreboard Operations

**STATUS:** Part-Time; Non-Exempt

  

**San Diego Padres Commitment**:

  

The San Diego Padres are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for our employees. We strive to create an environment for everyone by including perspectives from backgrounds that vary by race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, and national origin.

  

*If you are not sure you’re 100% qualified but are up for the challenge – we want you to apply. We believe* *skills are transferable and passion for our mission goes a long way.*

  

**San Diego Padres Petco Park Promise:**

Our service values drive our behaviors to create the best experience for all our guests who visit Petco Park. As a team member at Petco Park, we genuinely and passionately care about our guests, our ballpark, and each other. We make meaningful and memorable connections that set us apart from other venues and experiences. Each position on our team actively lives out this nonnegotiable commitment every day to CARE, CONNECT, EXCEED.

  

**Your role as an Audio Technician:**

You will be primarily responsible for ensuring high-quality audio production for Padres games, concerts, and other special events held at Petco Park, including Gallagher Square.

  

**All the responsibilities we will trust you with:**

* Exemplifying our Petco Park Promise: CARE, CONNECT, EXCEED by proactively welcoming all guests to the ballpark and consistently striving to exceed all guests' expectations
* Operating various audio mixing boards, microphones, speakers, and other audio equipment during Padres games, concerts, and special events
* Setting up and operating audio systems throughout the ballpark, including Gallagher Square, while working independently or as part of a team
* Setting up microphones, stage wedges, stage snakes, subwoofers, front fills, monitors, FOH processors, and related equipment for concerts, live entertainment, and special events
* Performing line and sound checks, including those for national anthems and other musical performances, to ensure equipment is functioning properly
* Operating control consoles to monitor and adjust audio levels, ensuring the correct audio feeds and appropriate volume levels throughout the ballpark
* Assisting the Audio Engineer with power distribution, cable runs, audio signal routing, and stage and FOH cable management
* Collaborating with Padres Front Office employees, technical staff, touring production teams, vendors, and special guests to meet event-specific audio needs while maintaining a calm and professional demeanor
* Troubleshooting and maintaining audio equipment and keeping detailed equipment inventories
* Working with Ballpark Management to coordinate local audio systems with the house audio system for various events
* Supporting control room operations for Padres games and in-stadium entertainment, including working with the A1 and DJs to deliver the best possible sound experience for fans
* Keeping up with the team's performance on the field, current organizational news, and demonstrating general baseball and Padres history knowledge
* Performing a variety of duties, including rotation based on departmental needs, and assuming other responsibilities as assigned by the Vice President of Broadcasting & Presentation, Director of Scoreboard Operations, Director of Event Production & Video Engineering, Manager of Engineering, and Audio Engineer

  

**Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most:**

* Being consistent, punctual, and having reliable attendance
* Having strong knowledge of audio system signal flow and the operation of microphones, speakers, amplifiers, and digital/analog audio mixers
* Understanding microphone and line-level input signal flow and having basic knowledge of distributed audio systems
* Having excellent communication skills and a positive, energetic personality
* Possessing proficient computer skills with the ability to multitask, react quickly to live event and game action, and maintain attention to detail
* Possessing a high degree of discretion, integrity, and accountability
* Working collaboratively and respectfully with others in a fast-paced, high-pressure, team-oriented environment
* Having strong knowledge of baseball and the Padres organization

  

**Additional knowledge and experience we'd love for you to bring (preferred, but not required):**

* Relevant experience supporting audio operations for concerts, live entertainment, festivals, large-scale special events, television production, scoreboard operations, or comparable production/control room environments.
* Experience operating or serving as a system engineer for L-Acoustics audio systems, particularly the L-Acoustics L2 PA system in Gallagher Square

* Familiarity with digital audio mixing consoles, including Allen & Heath dLive C1500, DiGiCo Quantum 225, and Allen & Heath SQ5
* Experience with concert audio equipment, stage and FOH power distribution, cable management, and audio signal routing, including AVB and Dante protocols
* Experience collaborating with touring production teams, audio engineers, and other live entertainment professionals
* Bachelor's degree in audio production, entertainment technology, or a related field
* Being bilingual in English and Spanish

  

**You will be required to meet the following:**

jobs.description:
***A great experience starts with you!***
=========================================

Join our team to help create and develop the future of live entertainment and sports in Orange County!

Once you've had a chance to explore our current open positions, apply to the ones you feel best suit you, as an applicant, you can always see your application status in your profile.

**Mission:** To be a place where the everyday becomes extraordinary - and the potential is unlimited. Where every experience can change you

**Vision:** We are the gathering place of Orange County

**Values:** Be Safe | Do the Right Thing | Be Generous | Include Everyone | Make it Easy | Be Bold

**Job Title:**
--------------

Lead Audio Engineer

**Pay Details:**

The starting hourly rate range for this position is $45.50 to $52.50 per hour. The actual hourly rate offered will take internal value, peer equity, job-related factors, and other organizational considerations into account.

The Lead Audio Engineer provides technical leadership to a team of audio technicians in delivering exceptional audio experiences across Honda Center and related event spaces. This role supports Anaheim Ducks home games, special events, select concerts, restaurants, clubs, indoor and outdoor venues, live production shoots, and audio editing needs. The position is responsible for the operation, maintenance, staffing, inventory, and repair of interior and exterior audio systems, including arena intercom and communications systems.

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with clients, event managers, vendors, and creative teams to define project objectives, budgets, technical requirements, and desired guest experience.
* Lead audio operations for live events ranging from a 17,000-seat arena to small meeting and hospitality spaces.
* Plan and manage audio projects, including staffing, equipment, schedules, system configuration, and quality-control procedures.
* Partner with Multimedia, Video, Lighting, and production teams to deliver integrated event and broadcast solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop audio technicians and junior engineers, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented team environment.
* Support video production teams with pre-production, live production, and post-production audio needs.
* Manage radio-frequency coordination and support reliable wireless audio operations.
* Identify and implement innovative audio strategies that enhance the guest experience, including within OCVIBE event spaces.
* Maintain current knowledge of audio-production technologies, workflows, standards, and industry trends.
* Manage audio equipment inventory and ensure equipment is properly maintained, tested, calibrated, documented, and ready for use.
* Establish and maintain quality standards for live audio, recorded content, communications, and other audio deliverables.
* Coordinate with event vendors and television broadcast trucks to ensure audio and communications requirements are met.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve operational issues, service concerns, and emergency repairs promptly and effectively.
* Monitor live audio mixes while simultaneously receiving and responding to production direction and cues.
* Manage multiple concurrent priorities effectively in a fast-paced live-event environment.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in live-event audio engineering, production, or a related field, preferably within an arena, entertainment venue, broadcast, or similarly complex production environment.
* Prior experience leading or providing technical direction to audio technicians or production teams is strongly preferred.
* Advanced knowledge of professional entertainment and live-event audio systems.
* Proficiency with Yamaha CL5 digital mixing consoles or comparable platforms.
* Proficiency with Dante, MADI, Q-SYS, and related audio-networking and signal-distribution technologies.
* Strong understanding of audio engineering best practices, including signal flow, system routing, gain structure, loudspeaker placement, and microphone selection and placement.
* Proficiency with Riedel communications systems; experience with Evertz routing systems is preferred.
* Understanding of emergency-notification and assistive-listening systems, including hard-of-hearing (HOH) announcement systems.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to follow direction, collaborate across disciplines, and maintain a professional, solutions-oriented approach in demanding live-event environments.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule that may include weekdays, weekends, holidays, split shifts, late nights, and overnight shifts.
* Ability to perform the essential physical functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation, including prolonged standing and walking; bending; reaching; working with arms raised; navigating concrete, uneven, and slippery surfaces; repeatedly lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds; climbing portable and fixed ladders; and occasionally working at heights above 10 feet.
* Ability to work in indoor and outdoor environments that may include temperature changes, inclement weather, bright lighting, loud noise, dust, and other conditions.
* Ability to remain current with emerging production technologies and learn new systems and workflows.
* Ability to install, configure, troubleshoot, and operate audio interfaces and signal.

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

**Education -** High School Diploma or Equivalent

**Experience Required -** 5+ Year's

This position is on-site.
